funders.name: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H) / NIH
funders.agent_search_hints: Check ARPA-H Open BAA for broad mission areas and NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts filtering by AI.

funders.name: Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA)
funders.agent_search_hints: Search SAM.gov for DARPA BAAs (especially I2O, DSO, STO). AIE solicitations have fast 90-day turnaround windows.

funders.name: Department of Energy (DOE) - Office of Science
funders.agent_search_hints: Check Advanced Scientific Computing Research (ASCR) program announcements on OSTI.gov.

funders.name: National Science Foundation (NSF)
funders.agent_search_hints: Filter solicitations by keywords "Artificial Intelligence" or "CISE". Check Dear Colleague Letters (DCLs) for supplements.

funders.name: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
funders.agent_search_hints: Look for Administration for Community Living (ACL) and CDC challenges related to AI assistive tools.

funders.name: Amazon Science
funders.agent_search_hints: Runs twice a year (Spring & Fall). Awards unrestricted cash gifts (up to $80K) plus AWS promotional credits ($20K-$40K).

funders.name: Reid Hoffman Foundation / Aphorism Foundation
funders.agent_search_hints: Check Lever for Change open challenges funded by Reid Hoffman and Stanford HAI partnerships.

funders.name: Alfred P. Sloan Foundation
funders.agent_search_hints: Sloan Research Fellowships deadline is typically September; digital technology grants review Letters of Inquiry year-round.

funders.name: Bezos Earth Fund
active_programs_sample: AI for Climate and Nature Grand Challenges ($100M initiative)
funders.agent_search_hints: Funds large institutional initiatives and open calls addressing planetary challenges using AI.

funders.name: Jump Trading (Conference Travel Grants)
funders.agent_search_hints: Full travel grants covering flight tickets, lodging, visa fees, and daily meal stipends ($1,000–$10,000) for top STEM students attending major research conferences.

funders.name: Plug and Play Tech Center
funders.agent_search_hints: Often operates state/city-backed innovation hubs with non-dilutive pilot opportunities and corporate sponsors.

funders.name: Y Combinator
active_programs_sample: YC Winter & Summer Batches ($500K standard deal)
funders.agent_search_hints: Check Requests for Startups (RFS) for specific AI verticals YC is eager to fund.

funders.name: NSF ACCESS (Advanced Cyberinfrastructure)
funders.agent_search_hints: Primary US academic supercomputer allocation. Explore track requires no formal proposal for rapid compute.

funders.name: Cyclotron Road / Lawrence Berkeley National Lab
active_programs_sample: Cyclotron Road Fellowship ($500K+ value per fellow)
funders.agent_search_hints: Provides two-year fellowship stipends, health benefits, travel, and world-class laboratory facility access at Berkeley Lab.

funders.name: NSF Major Research Instrumentation (MRI)
funders.agent_search_hints: Institutional submission limits apply (max 4 proposals per university). Submission window mid-October to mid-November.

funders.name: Harvard University - Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society
funders.agent_search_hints: Annual fellowship application window closes in late autumn for the subsequent academic year.

funders.name: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS)
funders.agent_search_hints: Offers 3-6 month fellowships with competitive stipends supporting policy research.

funders.name: Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute
funders.agent_search_hints: Check Mila AI4Humanity and policy pages for international visiting scholar and fellow calls.

funders.name: Princeton Center for Information Technology Policy (CITP)
funders.agent_search_hints: Posts fellowship openings in early winter for academic year appointments.

funders.name: Stanford University (AIMI & Center for Digital Health)
funders.agent_search_hints: AIMI awards annual seed grants up to $100K for interdisciplinary AI-in-medicine investigations.

funders.name: The House Fund / UC Berkeley BAIR
funders.agent_search_hints: Non-dilutive grants awarded directly to Berkeley AI research projects exploring startup potential.

funders.name: Grants.gov (Federal Portal)
active_programs_sample: Federal Opportunities across NSF, DOE, NIH, DARPA, NIST
funders.agent_search_hints: Use search-grants API or web portal with keyword "artificial intelligence" and status "Forecasted|Posted".

funders.name: SAM.gov (Federal Contract & BAA Portal)
funders.agent_search_hints: The official registry for Broad Agency Announcements (BAA) and federal procurement solicitations.
